cves.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection
cves.description: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
cves.exploit_status: Active exploitation observed in the wild
mitigations: Upgrade to fixed PAN-OS releases immediately
Disable GlobalProtect portal if unused
Apply Threat Prevention signatures from vendor advisory

cves.title: MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection (Cl0p)
cves.description: SQL injection in the MOVEit Transfer web application enables unauthenticated attackers to gain access to the database and subsequently execute arbitrary code, associated with Cl0p ransomware campaigns.
mitigations: Apply Progress Software patches immediately
Disable HTTP/HTTPS traffic to MOVEit if patching delayed
Hunt for webshells under wwwroot

cves.title: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bounds Write
cves.description: An out-of-bounds write in FortiOS SSL VPN may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.
cves.exploit_status: Exploitation reported; prioritize internet-facing SSL VPN
mitigations: Upgrade FortiOS to fixed versions
Disable SSL VPN if not required
Restrict SSL VPN access by geography and MFA

cves.title: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
cves.description: JNDI injection in Log4j allows remote code execution when attacker-controlled strings are logged. Remains relevant for legacy unpatched Java services.
cves.exploit_status: Widely exploited historically; still scanned continuously
mitigations: Upgrade to Log4j 2.17.1+ or equivalent fixed release
Set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true where applicable
Block outbound LDAP/RMI from app servers

cves.title: JetBrains TeamCity Authentication Bypass
cves.description: Authentication bypass vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform admin actions on TeamCity servers, frequently leveraged for CI/CD compromise and cloud credential theft.
mitigations: Upgrade TeamCity immediately
Remove TeamCity from direct internet exposure
Rotate all secrets stored in TeamCity after patching

cves.title: Citrix NetScaler Information Disclosure (Session Hijacking)
cves.description: Sensitive information disclosure that can lead to session token theft ('CitrixBleed'), enabling authentication bypass on appliances.
mitigations: Apply Citrix mitigations and firmware updates
Kill all active sessions after patching
Rotate credentials for users who authenticated through the appliance

cves.title: PHP CGI Argument Injection (Windows)
cves.description: Argument injection in PHP CGI mode on Windows allows remote code execution, exploited against internet-facing PHP applications.
mitigations: Upgrade PHP to patched versions
Avoid exposing PHP-CGI directly to the internet
Deploy WAF rules blocking crafted query strings

cves.title: Microsoft Exchange Server SSRF
cves.description: Server-side request forgery in Exchange allows authenticated attackers to elevate and, chained with RCE flaws, take over Exchange servers.
cves.exploit_status: Chained with RCE in the wild historically
mitigations: Apply Exchange cumulative updates and security patches
Enable Exchange Emergency Mitigation Service
Restrict Outlook Web Access exposure
